titulo_es: A family of words · Composite words and references

texto: In Danish, many words join together and the last element usually determines the type of thing: «arbejdsplads» is a workplace. For a reference, look for the noun to which they refer «den», «det» or «de».
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
